# ~/.zsh/ Directory

This directory stores cached shell completions for performance.

## Files (auto-generated, not committed)

These files are generated automatically and should NOT be committed:

- `kubectl.zsh` - kubectl completion (regenerates when kubectl updates)
- `gh.zsh` - GitHub CLI completion (regenerates when gh updates)
- `uv.zsh` - uv completion (regenerates when uv updates)

## Setup

Create the directory if it doesn't exist:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.zsh
```

The completions will be auto-generated on first shell startup.
